newsitem.title: ITALY: Arafat to stop in Naples to brief Italians.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to stop in Naples to brief Italians.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is to make a stop-over in Naples on Friday to brief Italian officials on the outcome of the Washington Mideast summit, officials said.
"We had contacts last night and this morning. Arafat has said he would like to come to inform us of the outcome of the Washington meeting," a Foreign Ministry spokesman said in Naples.
Palestinian sources in Rome also said the meeting would take place in Naples on Friday afternoon.
Arafat would hold talks with Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini, both of whom are in Naples for a Franco-Italian summit with French President Jacques Chirac.
The officials said Arafat would not hold talks with Chirac in Naples. Instead the Palestinian leader would fly on to Paris for a previously scheduled meeting with him there.
Arafat took part in a Middle East peace summit with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, King Hussein of Jordan and President Bill Clinton in Washington earlier this week.
